g.text: Google sign-in through Better Auth on the API, the sign-in decision, and how protected routes guard themselves
exchange the code for the ID token
create the User and Sign-in identity on the first sign-in
store the fresh ID token, OAuth tokens encrypted
allow: active User, refresh name and avatar
User restore: deleted within the Grace period
30 days: clear deletedAt, refresh name and avatar
to the error URL, no Session
allow or User restore: create the Session (7 days)
web app request with the Session cookie
look up the Session and its User
401 unauthorized: no Session, or a deleted User
otherwise the route runs as that User
Tag route with an API key
Better Auth makes a Session from the key
a missing or invalid key gets 401 first
